changelog: 1.0.0 — première version : brouillon préparé, validé par la personne responsable ou un avocat ; sources citées par référence, jamais par citation.

inputs.prompt: Write the public privacy and governance policy of a Québec firm, in Québec French and in plain language. Firm: {{inputs.firmName}}. Activities: {{inputs.activities}}. Information collected: {{inputs.dataKinds}}. Retention: {{inputs.retention}}. Contact role of the person in charge: {{inputs.contactRole}}. Sections: who we are, what we collect and why, who sees it, how long we keep it, your rights and how to use them, how to complain, the person in charge. Cite your sources by reference only, never by quoting a text: the Act respecting the protection of personal information in the private sector (RLRQ, c. P-39.1) as amended by Law 25 (S.Q. 2021, c. 25), with the section numbers that apply, and the guides of the Commission d'accès à l'information du Québec (CAI). Never reproduce the wording of a section. Open with this exact sentence: « Brouillon préparé par Orazaka — ce n'est pas un avis juridique : la personne responsable de la protection des renseignements personnels ou un avocat doit le valider avant tout usage. » Mark anything missing « À confirmer »; never invent a practice.

Translate this policy into plain English, section by section, keeping « To confirm » for every « À confirmer » and the validation sentence translated as: « Draft prepared by Orazaka — not legal advice: the person in charge of the protection of personal information or a lawyer must validate it before any use. » Policy: {{steps.french.content}}
